root_cause.reported_error: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toLowerCase') at moduleClass() — apps/web/features/operator/GovernanceWorkspace.tsx
root_cause.mechanism: normalizeShellEnvelope sets envelope.approvals = the Today decision cards ({id,title,meta,status,cta,tone,target}). OperatorConsole passed that array into GovernanceWorkspace, so the module/status badge helpers ran .toLowerCase() on fields the cards never carry. A navigation that happened before the bootstrap envelope resolved looked healthy; the crash only appeared once the delayed envelope landed on the Govern route.

remediation.principle: Admission, not repair. A record is admitted only if it carries the fields that identify it as governance data; every other field is carried through only when present and textual, and an absent field stays absent and is rendered as an explicit unavailable marker.

changes.summary: Admission gate for external governance rows. Required: approval id/module/title/status, decision id/module/item, audit id/action, status-board rows fully reported (named subject + status + boolean health + note), evidence packages fully reported. No default is ever substituted; non-textual values (for example the canonical AVM structured systemRecommendation) are treated as absent instead of reaching the render path.

Contract made honest: requestor/submittedAt, decision content and audit category/timestamp are optional because the canonical Governance modules (SiteScore / AVM / NetPlan / PriceOps) legitimately omit them, and GovernanceApprovalStatus stays open so a raw API status is reported as-is instead of coerced to "pending".

Badge helpers stay total; absent fields render the explicit 未提供 marker instead of 中 / 系統 / a stand-in name; audit rows without a category no longer add a nameless filter chip; rows supplied by a caller that stops supplying a governance feed are cleared rather than left stale.

envelope.approvals is no longer forwarded to Govern. Only explicitly governance-shaped bootstrap side channels (governanceApprovals / governanceDecisions / governanceAuditRows) are forwarded, through the admission gate, and a side channel the new envelope does not carry is cleared so rows from a superseded envelope cannot survive.

Regression coverage: drop-not-repair for foreign and malformed rows, explicit unavailable markers for incomplete governance rows, side-channel withdrawal at both the workspace and the console, API-as-source-of-truth over shell rows, production fail-closed, and the three navigation paths plus direct route and reload under a delayed envelope (19 tests).
